# Ultralight SDK

Download the free macOS ARM64 SDK from <https://ultralig.ht/download> after
reviewing and accepting its license, then extract its contents into this
directory. The build expects `include/`, `bin/`, `resources/`, and `license/`.

The tested archive is `ul-sdk-2.0.0-beta.2-mac-arm64-free.7z`, SHA-256
`87c679eba7d00eacfb81549a24754c1d87868dcfa82800b8be2719a74971b91c`.
The SDK binaries and headers are deliberately not committed. You can instead
set `ASTRA_ULTRALIGHT_SDK` to an extracted SDK elsewhere.
